blocks.text: Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul played the saxophone at a government reception attended by about 3,000 guests in Bangkok last Friday (October 16), welcoming international financial leaders with music and a message about the economic opportunities offered by Thai food, culture and hospitality. Government spokesman Ekkapob Pianpises said Anutin presided over the Thai Government Reception at One Bangkok Forum in Pathum Wan district. The event was held as Thailand hosted the 2026 Annual Meetings of the Boards of Governors of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the World Bank Group.
